title.zh: 苹果起诉OpenAI：硬件主管与前上司关系紧张
title.en: Apple's OpenAI lawsuit follows months of simmering tensions and highlights OpenAI's hardware chief Tang Tan's strained relationship with former boss John Ternus

summary.zh: 苹果对OpenAI提起诉讼，揭示了硬件主管唐坦与前上司John Ternus之间的紧张关系。

title.zh: 欧盟计划年底前提议新数字规则保护消费者
title.en: EU Justice Commissioner Michael McGrath says the EC is set to propose new digital rules by year-end aimed at protecting consumers from online spending traps

summary.zh: 欧盟司法专员Michael McGrath表示，欧盟委员会将提出新数字规则，旨在保护消费者免受在线消费陷阱的影响。

title.zh: SK海力士在美上市押注AI热潮打破存储芯片周期
title.en: SK Hynix's historic US stock market listing is a bet that the AI boom is breaking the memory chip industry's decades-long boom-and-bust cycle

summary.zh: SK海力士在美国股市的历史性上市，旨在利用AI热潮打破存储芯片行业长期的周期性波动。

title.zh: 分析显示四分之一长文社交媒体帖子由AI生成
title.en: An analysis of 1M+ social media posts from April 24 to June 30: ~25% of longform posts with 250+ words were fully AI-generated; on LinkedIn, the figure was 41%

summary.zh: 对超过100万条社交媒体帖子的分析显示，约25%的250字以上长文帖子完全由AI生成，其中LinkedIn的比例高达41%。

title.zh: Cursor开发通用AI代理Sand，挑战Claude Cowork
title.en: Sources: Cursor is building a general-purpose AI agent codenamed Sand, aimed at non-developers, that handles emails, texts, and documents to rival Claude Cowork

summary.zh: 消息称Cursor正在开发代号为Sand的通用AI代理，面向非开发者用户，支持处理邮件、文本和文档。

title.zh: 博科圣地利用AI聊天机器人设计武器和策划攻击
title.en: How members of the extremist group Boko Haram are using AI chatbots to design explosives, fix or upgrade weapons, and brainstorm attack ideas

summary.zh: 极端组织博科圣地成员正在利用AI聊天机器人设计爆炸物、修复或升级武器，并策划攻击方案。
